collection: NASA/USGS Harmonized Landsat and Sentinel-2 (HLS) S30 v2.0
reflectance_conversion: Multiply stored int16 surface reflectance values by 0.0001; nodata/fill is -9999.
qa_policy: Exclude fill and Fmask bits 1-4 (cloud, adjacent cloud/shadow, cloud shadow, snow/ice). Keep bit 5 (water) as a diagnostic; bit 0 is reserved in HLS v2.0.

scenes.site: Ras El Ma / Ras Kebdana, Morocco
scenes.timing_note: This scene was acquired one day before the field survey dated 2024-08-08.

redistribution_note: LP DAAC guidance states current products may be reused and redistributed without restrictions and requests proper citation; see DATA_LICENSE.md and the linked product DOI.
